name: Fernie & the Rockies
gettingAround: Fly into Calgary (YYC). Drive about 1.5 h to Banff (estimate, check on a map)
Banff to Fernie is about 3.5 h by road (estimate)
Fernie to West Glacier is about 3 h through the Roosville border crossing (estimate; check the crossing's current hours)
Fly out of Kalispell (FCA), about 1 h from West Glacier (estimate)

todos.text: Book Banff accommodation for July 3–5 (house or apartment, not a hotel)
Book Glacier-area accommodation for July 8–9 (house or cabin)
Book flights into Calgary (YYC) and out of Kalispell (FCA)
Check nps.gov Logan Pass and Going-to-the-Sun rules in spring 2027; shuttle tickets release on Recreation.gov
Confirm the Fernie house is ready for July 5–8

places.name: Banff Legacy Trail
places.location: Bow Valley Parkway (start at Cascade Ponds) to the Banff East Gate, 22.3 km of paved path
places.details: Shared with walkers and skaters; rolling, with a few short steep marked hills. Pedestrians use the pedestrian gate at the electrified mats.

places.name: Tunnel49 Adventures
places.details: Full-day whitewater (Class 2–4, 16 km through Elk Canyon) and a half-day Ghostrider family trip for ages 3+. Phone 250-423-5008.

places.name: Glacier Raft Company
places.location: West Glacier, on the Middle Fork of the Flathead River
places.details: Half-day whitewater, 2–3.5 hours; from $50 USD per adult or child (12 and under) plus 8% service fee and guide tip. Minimum age varies by month (about 5–12) and 50 lb. Booking 1-406-888-5454.

images.credit: Photo from Glacier Raft Company (Glacier Park Collection)
images.license: Operator's own photo, used with credit

places.name: Bear Street Outfitters (bike rental)
places.details: Standard and e-bikes, well reviewed for trail and Bow Valley rides. +1 877-447-1934.

places.name: Black Tie Ski & Bike Rentals (bike rental)
places.location: 201 Lynx St, Banff, at Banff Park Lodge
places.details: E-bikes; reviewers say book early in summer. +1 825-398-9563.

places.name: GearHub Sports (bike rental)
places.details: Bikes and e-bikes, with trail advice from staff. +1 250-423-5555.

places.name: Canyon Raft Company
places.location: Elk River, Elko BC, about 30 min from Fernie
places.details: Guided Elk River float with cliff jumping; about 4 hours on the river, photos about $10 per person. +1 250-423-7226.

places.name: Rocky Mountain Raft Tours
places.details: Relaxed scenic float, about 45 minutes on the water, not whitewater. Good for families. +1 403-762-3632.

places.name: Chinook Rafting
places.location: Kananaskis River, about 1.5 hours from Banff
places.details: Grade 2–3 rapids, family-friendly, free photos from some guides. +1 866-330-7238.

places.name: Surveyors Lake
places.location: Kikomun Creek Provincial Park, about 30 min south of Fernie
places.details: Sandy beaches, shade, and a day-use area beside the campground. Described as warm and good for families.

places.name: Tie Lake
places.location: BC Forest Recreation Site, about 45 min south of Fernie near Jaffray
places.details: Good for swimming, boating and camping. Facilities and water temperature not confirmed.

images.credit: Photo by Intricate Explorer on Unsplash

places.name: Fairy Creek Falls Trail
places.location: Fernie, about 4 km round trip, gentle
places.details: Cascading, misty waterfall, best in early summer. Starts at the Fernie Visitor Information Centre on Hwy 3.

images.credit: Photo by Hunter Reilly on Unsplash

places.name: Peyto Lake Viewpoint
places.location: Banff area, 2.6 km round trip, 80 m gain
places.details: Views of Peyto Lake from its second viewpoint.

images.credit: Photo by Jelmer Borst on Unsplash

places.name: Moraine Lake Rockpile
places.details: Moraine Lake and the Rockpile lookout.

images.credit: Photo by Jacky Huang on Unsplash

places.name: Bow Lake Lakeshore
places.details: Lakeshore walk with Crowfoot Mountain views.

places.name: Johnston Canyon
places.details: Lower and Upper Falls, with an optional Ink Pots side loop.

images.credit: Photo by Meressa Chartrand on Unsplash

places.name: Johnson Lake

places.location: Mountain bike route to the old townsite near Fernie
places.details: Not paved; for stronger riders.

places.name: Banff Gondola
places.details: Gondola up Sulphur Mountain. Check current ticket prices and times. about C$66 per person (2025 article; check). Daily 10 am–9 pm. Phone +1 866 756 1904.

places.name: Banff Upper Hot Springs
places.details: Hot springs pool. Parking costs extra. about C$20 per person (reviews). Hours not on Google; check before going. Phone +1 800 767 1611.

places.name: Lake Minnewanka
places.location: Lake Minnewanka Scenic Dr, Banff National Park
places.details: Lake in Banff National Park. Hours not listed.

places.name: Vermilion Lakes
places.details: Lakeside walk on the edge of Banff.

places.name: Banff Hoodoos
places.details: Hoodoos Trail. Check the round-trip distance against the 5-mile hike limit.

places.name: Sundance Canyon
places.details: Canyon trail. Check the round-trip distance against the 5-mile hike limit.

places.name: WOLFIES dinette
places.details: Small table-service spot. Strong seafood: calamari, mackerel, arctic char and clams. Reviews rate it 4.9. Book ahead; groups of 6+ reserve by email. ~C$50–90 per person. Mon–Sat 5–10 pm, Sun closed.

places.name: Bridge Bistro
places.location: 301 BC-3, by the Elk River, Fernie
places.details: Riverside bistro. Fish and chips, clam chowder, full bar. Takes reservations. ~C$20–30 per person. Daily 9 am–9 pm. Phone +1 250 423 3002.

places.name: The Fernie Taphouse
places.details: Locals' pub known for Fernie Famous Fish & Chips. Family-friendly, with a patio. The Google listing shows a recent name change, so confirm it is the same place. Daily 11 am–midnight (Fri–Sat to 12:30 am). Phone +1 250 423 6444.

places.name: Yamagoya Sushi
places.details: Sushi, seafood and ramen. Expect a wait at peak hours; reservations accepted. ~C$30–60 per person. Daily 5–10 pm. Phone +1 250 430 0090.

places.name: Bramasole Restaurant & Wine Bar
places.details: Italian wine bar and local favourite. Reserve ahead. ~C$30–90 per person. Daily 5–10 pm. Phone +1 250 430 0526.

places.name: White Birch Cafe & Bistro
places.details: Breakfast, including creative Eggs Benedict. ~C$20–30 per person. Daily 7 am–1 pm. Phone +1 250 430 4570.

places.name: Himalayan Spice Bistro
places.details: Long-running Himalayan and Indian restaurant, named among the area's best by Avenue Calgary. ~C$20–30 per person. Daily 4–10 pm. Phone +1 250 430 0399.

places.name: Fernie Cattle Company
places.details: Steakhouse that also serves rainbow trout and seafood. Reservations recommended. Tables of 6 or more get a 20% service charge. ~C$30–80 per person. Daily 4:30–9:30 pm. Phone +1 250 423 7498.

places.name: Good Folk
places.details: Farm-to-table: oysters, Hokkaido scallops, West Coast sablefish. Book dinner ahead. Daily 7 am–noon and 4–10 pm. Phone +1 403 760 8505.

places.name: The Maple Leaf Steak & Seafood
places.details: Maple salmon, prawns, lobster tail, king crab and oysters. Reservations recommended. Tue–Sun 10 am–2:30 pm and 4–9 pm, Mon closed. Phone +1 403 760 7680.

places.name: The Prow at Buffalo Mountain Lodge
places.details: Lemon conchigliette with seafood and clam chowder, in a lodge setting. Reserve dinner. ~C$20–70 per person. Daily 7 am–10 pm. Phone +1 403 760 4484.

places.name: Tooloulous
places.details: Cajun: crab, shrimp and grits, fish and chips. Dinner reservations strongly recommended. ~C$20–30 per person. Tue–Fri 8 am–9 pm per the Google listing; confirm. Phone +1 403 762 2633.

places.name: Bare Bistro by Fedoras cakes and bakes
places.details: Family-run breakfast spot, rated 4.9. Free parking. ~C$20–30 per person. Mon–Fri 6:30 am–2 pm, Sat–Sun closed. Phone +1 403 760 2677.

places.name: Farm & Fire
places.details: Farm-to-table, with rotisserie chicken and a patio fireplace. Reserve brunch and dinner. Mixed reviews. ~C$20–30 per person. Daily 7 am–2 pm and 5–9 pm. Phone +1 403 760 3298.

places.name: Brazen
places.details: Local dishes with Banff-area ingredients, including bison kofta and smoked striploin. Dinner reservations recommended. ~C$20–80 per person. Daily 7 am–9 pm. Phone +1 403 760 8540.

places.name: Three Bears Brewery & Restaurant
places.details: Brewpub that locals use. Reserve on weekends. ~C$20–60 per person. Daily 11:30 am–9 pm (Fri–Sat to 9:30 pm). Phone +1 403 985 8038.

places.name: Hankki
places.details: Counter service, cheap takeout. ~C$10–20 per person. Daily 11:30 am–9 pm. Phone +1 403 762 0332.

places.name: The Bison Restaurant & Terrace
places.details: Splurge. Regional Alberta food, octopus, halibut. Reserve; expect a wait. ~C$100+ per person. Daily 5–9 pm (Fri–Sat from 4:30 pm). Phone +1 403 762 5550.

places.name: Wild Flour Bakery
places.details: Bakery on Bear Street. Daily 7 am–5 pm. Phone +1 403 760 5074.

places.name: Ramen Arashi
places.location: 213 Sundance Mall, 215 Banff Ave (2nd floor), Banff
places.details: Ramen. No reservations. Black arashi bowl about C$19. Daily 11:30 am–9 pm. Phone +1 403 760 0908.

places.name: Block Kitchen + Bar
places.details: Restaurant and bar on Banff Avenue. Daily 11:30 am–11 pm. Phone +1 403 985 2887.

places.name: The Fat Ox of Banff
places.details: Northern Italian. ~C$25–45 per person (approximate). Daily 12–10 pm (Mon–Fri from 2 pm). Phone +1 403 762 3848.

places.name: Banff Tea Co.
places.details: Tea shop. Daily 10 am–8 pm. Phone +1 403 762 8322.

places.name: Jolene's Tea House
places.details: Tea house on Bear Street. Daily 9 am–8 pm. Phone +1 403 985 5500.

places.name: Evelyn's Coffee Bar
places.details: Coffee bar on Banff Avenue. Daily 7 am–7 pm. Phone +1 403 762 2000.

places.name: Rocky Mountain Chocolate
places.details: Chocolate shop. To confirm: the 2002 article lists Mountain Chocolates at 119 Banff Ave. Daily 10 am–9 pm. Phone +1 403 985 0987.

places.name: The Grizzly House (tourist spot)
places.details: Landmark fondue and seafood restaurant, with hot-stone cooking of scallop, beef and lobster. Popular with visitors. Reservations strongly recommended. ~C$40–90 per person. Daily 11 am–9 pm (Fri–Sat to 9:30 pm). Phone +1 403 762 4055.

places.name: Sky Bistro (tourist spot)
places.location: 100 Mountain Ave, top of the Banff Gondola
places.details: Mountain-top Canadian restaurant with seafood chowder, bison and duck frites. Gondola ticket required; reserve lunch or dinner. Daily 11 am–7:30 pm. Phone +1 403 762 7486.

places.name: Cave and Basin National Historic Site
places.details: National Historic Site. Check current admission. Daily 9:30 am–5 pm. Phone +1 403 762 1566.

places.name: Lower Bankhead
places.location: Lake Minnewanka Scenic Dr, Banff National Park
places.details: Ruins of a former mining town. Bear country, with stairs.

places.name: The Whyte Museum of the Canadian Rockies
places.details: Museum about the Canadian Rockies. about C$15 per adult. Daily 10 am–5 pm. Phone +1 403 762 2291.

places.name: Willock & Sax Gallery
places.details: Art gallery. Daily 11 am–4 pm. Phone +1 403 762 2214.

places.name: Canada House Gallery
places.details: Art gallery. Daily 10 am–5 pm (Fri–Sat to 7 pm). Phone +1 403 762 3757.

places.name: Carter-Ryan Gallery
places.details: Art gallery. Wed–Sun 10 am–5 pm, Mon–Tue closed. Phone +1 403 985 5556.

places.name: Brandon T. Brown Wilderness Gallery
places.details: Wilderness art gallery. Daily 10 am–5 pm (Fri–Sat to 6 pm). Phone +1 403 953 0119.

places.name: Paper Den
places.details: A reviewer reported an online order that was never fulfilled, so pay in store. Daily 10 am–8:30 pm.
